Graduated from MEPhI and postgraduate studies at the Institute of Chemical Physics of the Russian Academy of Sciences.

He loves wild nature and tourism (especially mountain tourism). He loves beer, he can't live without it :). He listens to almost any music (from Vivaldi and Rachmaninov to gothic and jungle), respect Russian rock (Nau, DDT, Tequilajazz, Kovcheg). In Quake, he likes Hook and Shaft with Quad :). I am an admin of quake servers on ORC.
He has a calm character, but sometimes unpredictable :).
